evaluationSetTerminology.note: This is evaluation data. It is not a training set and no model training is authorized (mission section 22).

holdout.anchorRationale: Partition is anchored on the garment, not the case, so every capture of one physical product lands in the same partition. Anchoring on the case would let a development-partition capture leak the answer for its holdout twin.

assetStorage.rationale: See docs/DESIGN.md DM-01. Git LFS is installed on the machine but not governed in this repository (git lfs ls-files is empty, .gitattributes has no filter=lfs entry), so mission section 18's LFS carve-out does not apply and adopting it unilaterally would be an unauthorized, hard-to-reverse repository-weight decision.

currentCounts.note: Counts are DERIVED from the records on disk by lib/queue.js, never hand-maintained here. This block records only what was true when the corpus manifest was last written.
